test_item_verbatim: Selecting the “More AUX” again closes the popup

tcs.tc_title: pressing More AUX again closes the popup
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. Two wired AUX cameras are connected
4. The rear view camera image is displayed
5. The "More Aux" pop-up is open
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "More AUX" button again
2. Read the HU display and check that the pop-up is closed and the rear view camera image is still displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "More AUX" button registers the press
2. The pop-up is closed and the rear view camera image is still displayed
tcs.split_reason: pressing More AUX again closes the popup
tcs.test_item:
Selecting the “More AUX” again closes the popup

reasoning: §27.8.3 逐字。ER 加「後視影像仍顯示」一項 —— 關閉彈窗不應連帶退出相機視角，該判準取同節 §27.8.1 之情境（彈窗自後視影像開啟）。來源之按鍵名於 §27.8.1 寫 `“More Aux”`、§27.8.3 寫 `“More AUX”`，兩處大小寫不一；各列之 verbatim 逐字照錄，Procedure 依其所屬列之拼法。
remarks: SYS1 27.8.1 spells the button "More Aux" and 27.8.3 spells it "More AUX".
